svg.title: Estimated VCCIN current against the Dominus Extreme's cited 570A figure
svg.desc: Four horizontal bars show estimated total VCCIN current for a W-3175X: about 177 amps at stock, 222 amps at 400 watts, 356 amps at a 4.6 GHz overclock, and 417 amps at a 4.6 GHz AVX overclock, against the cited 570 amp sustained figure marked as a dashed red line. These are estimates, not measurements.
svg.text: Estimated VCCIN current vs. the board's cited 570A+ figure
Estimates — CPU power ÷ assumed VCCIN, shared equally across 32 stages. Not measured on my board.
~177 A · 31% of rating · ~5.5 A per stage
4.6 GHz overclock, AVX load — ~792 W @ ~1.9 V
Power figures: Tom's Hardware W-3175X review and overclocking article. Stages: 32× IR3555, 60A each. 570A+ sustained is a widely cited figure, not traced to an ASUS source. Voltages are assumptions.
Assumes all reported CPU power flows through VCCIN and the stages share load equally. Real values will differ.
